gates_examined.vocabulary_summary: Matches EMPTY_REFUSAL as an empty Refused: block; HOLLOW_NOUNS as the exact phrases 'the clinical quantity this page pools', 'the quantity this page pools', 'the outcome this page reports', and 'the clinical outcome of interest'; VERDICT_IN_TITLE as only NOT POOLABLE, NOT ESTABLISHED, NOT ASSESSABLE, or NOT COMPARABLE in title/H1/review-question; FOREIGN_TOPIC as the exact attr-pn phrase 'patisiran against its own saline placebo' off the attr-pn page; SENTINEL_SPLICE as selected absence markers followed by 'on the page this object was extracted/built from'; and CIRCULAR as 'The outcome/quantity/endpoint/estimand ... is the ... this page/review pools/reports/analyses/analyzes'.

unmatched_forms_found.verbatim_quote: Olmesartan in hypertension: Retired -- the titled drug is the comparator in all three trials and the intervention in none
unmatched_forms_found.why_same_defect: This is a page-status/audit verdict occupying the browser title and H1 rather than a clean article identity, the same VERDICT_AS_TITLE defect the gate exists to catch.
unmatched_forms_found.why_gate_misses_it: VERDICT_IN_TITLE only matches NOT POOLABLE, NOT ESTABLISHED, NOT ASSESSABLE, or NOT COMPARABLE, so the equivalent status word 'Retired' is outside the gate's vocabulary.

gates_examined.vocabulary_summary: Matches SLOT_FED and SLOT_LONG when a linking verb is followed by a shouted field-like token; TRUNCATED only as a one- or two-letter non-whitelisted fragment before a semicolon; LOST_TAIL only as 'pooled under random' or 'pooled under fixed' not followed by effects; ADVERB_SLOT only as 'was closely/loosely/tightly/broadly/narrowly ('; and STRAY_REFUSED as 'Refused:' followed by a number.

unmatched_forms_found.verbatim_quote: Methods. estimates were pooled under a random-effects with the REML estimator; risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2 (Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials); and certainty was rated with GRADE, following the Cochrane Handbook chapter 14. Randomised evidence starts HIGH and is rated down with reasons.
unmatched_forms_found.why_same_defect: The method sentence does not parse because 'a random-effects' is missing the noun it modifies, the same lost-tail/grammar defect class the gate documents.
unmatched_forms_found.why_gate_misses_it: The LOST_TAIL regex only looks for bare 'pooled under random' or 'pooled under fixed', so insertion of the article in 'pooled under a random-effects' avoids every listed check.

gates_examined.vocabulary_summary: Matches five stored-prose seams in ssot canonical object JSON: semicolon followed by the lead-in openers loaded from ssot/field_lead_ins.json; double full stop; the exact capitalized-opener form 'does not claim [A-Z]'; stranded '; .' or ', .'; and a space before a full stop.

unmatched_forms_found.verbatim_quote: The outcome sought is The registered primary of each trial, read verbatim.
unmatched_forms_found.why_same_defect: It embeds a capitalized sentence opener mid-clause, the same capitalization seam represented by the gate's planted 'does not claim That...' defect.
unmatched_forms_found.why_gate_misses_it: The gate's capitalized-opener pattern is the literal regex 'does not claim [A-Z]', so a seam after 'is' with the opener 'The' is not in its matched vocabulary.

scope_actually_covered: Ran gate_paper_reads_terribly_2026_08_24.py on 1473 root *_REVIEW.html pages, then scanned the 1470 passing pages' title/H1/review-question slots for status-verdict alternatives and verified OLMESARTAN_HTN_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html passes alone. Ran gate_paper_reads_as_prose_2026_08_22.py on 149 assessable root *_REVIEW.html/*_SSOT.html paper panels, then scanned all 144 passing paper panels for the malformed 'pooled under a random-effects' variant and verified AGYW_HIV_PREP_REVIEW.html passes alone. Ran gate_no_grammar_seam_in_stored_prose_2026_08_23.py on all 155 canonical ssot object JSON files, then ran a bounded variant search over the same two fields the gate reads: bookkeeping_2026_08_21 and manuscript. I did not inspect retired/removed directories, e156-submission asset copies, non-canonical ssot sidecars, scripts that would write their own output, or every possible English paraphrase of each defect.
self_doubt: The strongest empirical finding is the 19-page 'pooled under a random-effects' miss; the weakest judgment call is treating 'Retired -- ...' in a title as the same verdict-as-title defect, because a project policy could intentionally allow retirement routing text in titles even though this gate's own rationale argues against verdicts there.
